messages:
alex: ScaleWave alert in eu-central-1 — provisioning heartbeats suppressed. GPU instances stuck in PROVISIONING, autoscaler not triggering. High enqueue on infer-queue, tail latency climbing. Raising to @oncall.

maria: seeing it too. dashboard shows nodepool 'gpu-eu-prod' stuck at 0 -> requested 8. health checks failing with 503 from node-provisioner.

sanjay: pasting recent controller logs:
```
2026-02-18T10:05:12Z controller: heartbeat to provisioning-api timed out (x3)
2026-02-18T10:05:13Z provisioner: attachGPU failed: resource-unavailable (quota?)
2026-02-18T10:05:18Z autoscaler: desired=8 current=0 pending=0
```

ops-bot: [ALERT] ScaleWave provisioning suppression detected in eu-central-1. Incident created: #INC-7221

jen: any quota errors in cloud console? @liam can you check IAM/quota?

liam: checked — GPU quota looks fine. I see spike of preemptible evictions and creation errors: "network-interface-limit" on a subset of zones. Opening support ticket with cloud. :thinking_face:

alex: can we shift traffic to eu-west-1 or us-west-2? want minimal user impact. Plan: failover routing policy -> prefer us-west-2, degrade to smaller model (redwood-quant-small) if capacity limited.

maria: can we also enable canary fallback to cpu pool for low-priority traffic? latency will be higher but keeps requests alive.

sanjay: started a manual scale on nodepool in eu-west-1 as hot spare: `gcloud container node-pools resize gpu-west-1 --num-nodes=6` — it's in progress.

jen: added temporary route rule in traffic-router: `if region==eu-central then priority=failover_region:eu-west-1` — pushing now.

alex: added KV cache bypass for long-running sessions to reduce memory pressure: toggled cache_policy=manual for affected routes.

liam: cloud support replied — it's a soft quota: network interface limit per project in specific zone. They'll raise in ~2 hours. Short-term workaround: deploy into an unaffected zone (eu-central-2a) -> but that requires image distribution.

maria: distribution done to eu-central-2a, launching 4 instances now. If they attach, we'll kick autoscaler.

sanjay: instances launched but GPU attach failed with same error on two nodes. Looks like API upstream is returning 502 intermittently.

ops-bot: [UPDATE] Incident INC-7221: cloud provider investigating 502s on GPU attach API in eu-central-1.

jen: roll plan: 1) shift 60% traffic to eu-west-1, 2) route remaining to us-west-2 fallback, 3) enable reduced-model fallback. I've applied step 1, monitoring.

alex: monitoring shows queue depth drop by 45% within 8m after failover. tail p95 still high for priority routes; switching degraded-model for non-critical routes.

liam: cost note — shifting to us-west-2 increases egress & reserved pricing; we should revert asap.

maria: once cloud fix lands, we'll reverse routing and run a controlled scale to refill caches. leaving a runbook note in #incidents.

sanjay: done — tagged incident docs with commands used and timestamps.

alex: thanks all. postmortem to follow — suspected root cause: provider-side network-interface quota enforcement + intermittent attach API 502s leading to heartbeat suppression in our provisioner; autoscaler misread suppressed heartbeat as 'no demand' -> didn't scale. We need better health signal decoupling.

jen: action items: (1) add explicit attach-error metric to autoscaler decision, (2) fall back to cross-zone provisioning faster, (3) temp failover routing automation. Assigning: jen, sanjay, maria. @oncall please ack.

ops-bot: [RESOLVE] Incident INC-7221 marked as mitigated (traffic shifted, partial capacity recovered) — keep monitoring.

liam: acked. :white_check_mark:

maria: leaving a small note: consider cost-alerts when region reroute >2h.

alex: closing thread; thanks everyone. We'll schedule a 30-min blameless postmortem tomorrow.
